welcome.eyebrow: Your flight history, in your hands
welcome.title: The data outlives the app.
welcome.description: Create your own archive and add flights with a simple form. No JSON file is required. Your data stays in this browser.
welcome.privacy: Local by design. Nothing is uploaded.

demo.label: Demo archive
demo.description: You are exploring fictional sample flights. This is not your personal history.
demo.exportConfirmation: This is fictional demo data. Export it anyway?

flights.emptyDescription: Use the guided form to start your archive. Keepraw Fly handles the JSON format for you.

flightEditor.airlineCodeHint: Choose a suggestion or enter an unlisted 2-character IATA or 3-letter ICAO code.
flightEditor.serviceNumberHint: Enter the digits and optional suffix only, or paste a complete number such as MU589.
flightEditor.fullFlightNumber: The complete flight number will be saved as {{number}}
flightEditor.airportSearchHint: Search the offline global airport directory.
flightEditor.airportRecentHint: Choose a recent airport or start typing to search the offline directory.
flightEditor.localTimeNote: Enter each time as shown locally at its airport. Timezone offsets are added automatically.
flightEditor.optionalFactsDescription: Actual times, airport details, baggage, aircraft and seat
flightEditor.migratedArchive_one: One legacy format detail was updated in memory. The imported archive will be saved as Keepraw Fly 0.1.0.
flightEditor.migratedArchive_other: {{count}} legacy format details were updated in memory. The imported archive will be saved as Keepraw Fly 0.1.0.

flightEditor.arrivalBeforeDeparture: Arrival must be later than departure after timezone conversion.
flightEditor.actualArrivalBeforeDeparture: Actual arrival must be later than actual departure.

flightEditor.invalidAirlineCode: Enter a 2-character IATA or 3-letter ICAO airline code.
flightEditor.invalidServiceNumber: Enter 1 to 4 digits with an optional letter suffix.
flightEditor.invalidBookingClass: Enter a single letter for the booking class.
flightEditor.unknownAirport: Choose a valid airport from the offline directory.
flightEditor.invalidFlight: Please check the flight details and try again.
flightEditor.deleteConfirmation: Delete this flight from your archive?

flightDetail.routeAtlasDescription: Static route geometry from the offline airport directory.
flightDetail.routeAtlasLabel: Map of the recorded route from {{origin}} to {{destination}}

passport.mapDescription: A personal atlas shaped by every recorded journey.
passport.mapPreviewLabel: World map showing {{flights}} flights between recorded airports
passport.mapLegend: Color marks countries visited. Route depth reflects how often you returned.
passport.mapRouteData_one: {{origin}} to {{destination}} · {{count}} flight · First flown {{first}} · Last flown {{last}}
passport.mapRouteData_other: {{origin}} to {{destination}} · {{count}} flights · First flown {{first}} · Last flown {{last}}
passport.emptyTitle: Your passport starts with one flight.
passport.emptyDescription: Add your first record and Keepraw Fly will build this passport from your own flight facts.

import.exactDuplicateNote_one: {{count}} exact duplicate will be skipped. Existing data will not be overwritten.
import.exactDuplicateNote_other: {{count}} exact duplicates will be skipped. Existing data will not be overwritten.
import.includePossibleDuplicates_one: Also import {{count}} possible duplicate as a separate flight
import.includePossibleDuplicates_other: Also import {{count}} possible duplicates as separate flights
import.possibleDuplicateNote: These records share the same date, flight number and route, but their scheduled departure differs. They will not be merged or imported unless you choose this option.
import.preserveArchiveNote: Only the selected flights will be added. The current profile, existing flights and archive metadata stay unchanged.
import.blockingDescription: The file has issues that affect the records below. Nothing has been written to this browser.
import.moreIssues_one: One more issue is not shown.

issueMessages.parse: This is not valid JSON. Check that the file is complete and try again.
issueMessages.additionalProperties: This field is outside the Keepraw Fly core format. Preserve custom data inside a namespaced extensions object.
issueMessages.type: This value has the wrong data type.
issueMessages.format: This date or time is not in the required ISO 8601 format with an explicit timezone where needed.
issueMessages.pattern: This value does not match the required format.
issueMessages.const: This file identifies an unsupported format or version.
issueMessages.enum: This value is not one of the supported choices.
issueMessages.anyOf: This object is missing a supported identifying field.
issueMessages.uniqueFlightId: This flight id is repeated within the imported file.
issueMessages.serviceDate: The service date does not match the scheduled departure date.
issueMessages.chronology: An arrival time must be later than its departure time.

csvImport.timezoneNote: Scheduled times must be ISO 8601 values with an explicit offset, for example 2026-09-02T13:00:00+08:00. Flights are appended only after confirmation.
csvImport.invalidFile: This CSV could not be read. Include one header row and at least one flight row.

fileErrors.missing-rows: No flight rows were found. Include one header row and at least one flight row.
fileErrors.unterminated-quote: A quoted CSV field is not closed. Check the quotation marks and try again.
fileErrors.empty-header: One or more CSV columns have an empty header.
fileErrors.invalid-file: This CSV could not be read.

issues.incomplete-mapping: Map every required field before importing.
issues.invalid-flight-number: The flight number is not in the canonical Keepraw Fly format. It was not changed automatically.
issues.invalid-date: The service date must use YYYY-MM-DD.
issues.unknown-airport: The origin or destination is not an exact IATA code in the offline airport directory.
issues.same-airport: Origin and destination must be different airports.
issues.timezone-required: Scheduled times must include an explicit timezone offset.
issues.invalid-time: A scheduled time is not a real calendar date and time.
issues.date-mismatch: The service date must match the scheduled departure date.
issues.chronology: Scheduled arrival must be later than scheduled departure.

settings.description: Display preferences stay local. Profile names travel with your Keepraw Fly archive.
settings.importDescription: Validate and preview a Keepraw Fly JSON file. New flights are added after confirmation; existing flights are never overwritten.
settings.csvImportDescription: Map, validate and preview CSV columns. Flights are appended only after every row passes preflight.
settings.exportDescription: Download a complete, validated and portable copy of your facts.
settings.exportDescriptionDemo: This archive contains fictional demo flights. Export only if you need the sample file.
settings.clearDescription: Remove this flight archive from the current browser.
settings.clearConfirmation: Clear the local Keepraw Fly archive? Export first if you need a backup.
settings.powerUserDescription: Enable only if you understand the Keepraw Fly data model.
settings.advancedPlaceholder: Advanced editing is reserved for a future release. No raw editor is enabled yet.
